prompts.title: Businessman at Office Desk with Laptop Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic 8K professional executive portrait of a stylish man seated confidently behind a dark wooden office desk in a sophisticated, luxurious dark-toned office interior.
Subject & Appearance:
A well-styled man and a calm, serious, composed expression. He wears thin, elegant rectangular gold-metal eyeglasses. His face, facial proportions, skin tone, and natural features should remain highly realistic and authentic.
Outfit:
He wears a crisp white dress shirt with a black satin tie underneath a premium charcoal-gray textured quarter-zip sweater. The sweater has a refined subtle pattern, ribbed cuffs, and a polished luxury-business aesthetic. A sophisticated black luxury wristwatch with a dark dial is clearly visible on his left wrist.
Pose & Composition:
Seated upright and centered behind the desk with a confident yet relaxed posture. One forearms rest naturally on the laptop and other on the desk. He looks toward the camera with a calm, professional, composed expression.
Environment:
A premium dark executive office with charcoal-black wood paneling and built-in shelving in the background. Elegant decorative black ceramic vases, books, and subtle luxury décor are arranged on the shelves. Warm vertical accent lighting glows softly along the shelving. A modern desk lamp with a warm amber glow appears in the background on the right. A partially visible open laptop sits on the left side of the desk, while stacked dark notebooks and a pen are placed on the right.
Lighting:
Moody cinematic low-key lighting with a warm soft key light illuminating the face and upper body, creating natural skin highlights and gentle shadows. Warm practical lights in the background add depth and atmosphere, while subtle rim lighting separates the subject from the dark surroundings. Rich contrast, realistic shadows, soft highlights, and controlled exposure.
Camera & Quality:
Eye-level camera angle, medium waist-up portrait, 85mm professional portrait, shallow depth of field, f/2, sharp focus on the eyes and face, softly blurred background, realistic skin texture, detailed fabric, natural reflections, cinematic color grading, premium corporate editorial photography, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, 8K, vertical 4:5 composition. No ai generated face look.

prompts.title: The Modern Executive
prompts.prompt:
Ultra-realistic 8K cinematic medium portrait of a confident man. Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for 100% accurate face matching and identity reference. He has neatly styled hair and a well-groomed appearance. He is seated in a premium black leather chair, embodying a refined "quiet luxury" aesthetic.
Outfit: He wears a crisp slate-gray button-down dress shirt with the top buttons casually undone and the sleeves neatly rolled to the forearms, paired with tailored black trousers and premium brown loafers. A luxury golden chronograph watch is prominently displayed on his right wrist.
Composition: Centered medium portrait (mid-thigh to head), with the subject occupying most of the frame. Balanced composition with strong visual emphasis on the face and wristwatch, creating a confident and visually engaging focal point.
Pose:
Seated comfortably in a high-back leather executive chair with a relaxed yet confident posture. His body faces forward, while one leg is crossed casually over the other. The left forearm rests naturally across the torso, with the left hand adjusting the watch on his right wrist. The right elbow is bent, and the right hand is raised near the chest in a relaxed gesture. Shoulders remain relaxed and open.
Expression & Gaze: Warm and self-assured expression with a subtle, genuine smile. The eyes maintain direct eye contact with the camera, creating an approachable yet authoritative presence.
Background: Pure deep-black seamless studio backdrop with no distractions, creating a dramatic and sophisticated atmosphere.
Lighting: Professional low-key studio lighting with a classic Rembrandt pattern. A large diffused key light positioned camera-left illuminates the face and shirt, while the opposite side falls into soft, cinematic shadow. Subtle rim lighting separates the subject from the dark background, enhancing depth and dimensionality.
Camera Angle: Eye-level camera angle.
Technical Details: Ultra-realistic photography, photorealistic 8K resolution, DSLR-quality image, 85mm lens, f/1.8 aperture, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the eyes, facial features, and watch face, creamy background blur, realistic skin texture, hyper-detailed fabric folds and stitching, high dynamic range, cinematic contrast, luxury editorial fashion photography, magazine-cover quality, masterpiece, ultra-sharp detail.
Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Modern Business Leadership
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic professional corporate portrait based strictly on the uploaded reference image. The result should resemble a high-end CEO / executive portrait photographed in a modern luxury office, with commercial photography quality.
Reference Priority (Critical)
The uploaded reference image is the primary source for the subject’s face and identity.
The subject must remain clearly recognizable as the same person.
Subject Appearance
Young professional male with a confident corporate presence.
Hair: neatly styled dark hair with natural volume.

Expression: friendly, confident, soft smile.

Eyes looking directly into the camera.
Pose & Body Position
Professional executive desk portrait.

subject seated in an executive office chair
torso leaning slightly forward toward the desk
right hand resting on the laptop keyboard
left hand raised near the chin in a relaxed loose fist
posture natural, confident, and thoughtful
Wardrobe
Corporate executive attire:

light grey tailored single-breasted suit jacket with notched lapels
crisp white dress shirt
textured crimson red tie (grenadine / knit texture)
stainless steel silver link-bracelet watch on the left wrist
Desk & Foreground
Glossy black glass executive desk with strong reflections.
On the desk:

open space-gray laptop resembling a MacBook
Apple logo visible
reflection of the laptop, hands, and suit on the polished surface
Background Environment
Modern luxury office interior.
Background wall divided into two materials:
Left side

white marble slab with soft grey veining
Right side

rich dark walnut wood paneling
Above the marble panel:

a recessed wooden shelf with warm LED strip lighting creating a soft halo glow.
Lighting
Professional executive portrait lighting:

softbox key light from front-left illuminating the face evenly
warm LED ambient backlight from the shelf
soft cinematic shadows with controlled contrast
Composition
Medium portrait (waist-up).

subject centered in the frame
eyes aligned near the upper rule-of-thirds line
laptop visible in the foreground
background slightly blurred but clearly recognizable as a luxury office
Camera & Image Quality
85mm portrait lens
f/2.8 aperture
sharp focus on the eyes
detailed fabric textures
natural skin rendering
commercial studio photography quality
Technical Settings
Aspect Ratio: 4:5 vertical

Resolution: 8K ultra-high resolution

Style: luxury corporate executive portrait photography

Negative Prompts (Important)
Do not generate:

incorrect face or identity mismatch
altered facial proportions
cartoon, illustration, painting, CGI, 3D render
plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, artificial beauty filters
distorted face or asymmetrical facial features
extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed hands
unrealistic lighting or harsh blown highlights
messy desk or cluttered office
unrealistic reflections on desk
low resolution, blurry image, noise, compression artifacts
exaggerated HDR or oversaturated colors
